lesson_title: Minus Times Minus: Why It's Plus
hook_text: Everyone knows minus times minus is plus. Almost nobody can say WHY. Thirty seconds.
clip_script: Negative 3 times negative 2 means: take AWAY three debts of R2. Someone removes three R2 debts from your account. Each removal makes you R2 richer, so you end up R6 better off. Negative 3 times negative 2 is positive 6. Taking away debt is gaining money. And the pattern proves it too. 3 times negative 2 is negative 6. 2 times negative 2 is negative 4. 1 times negative 2 is negative 2. 0 times negative 2 is 0. Each time the first number drops by one, the answer goes up by 2. Keep going: negative 1 times negative 2 is 2, and negative 2 times negative 2 is 4. The pattern leaves no other choice.
visual_style: Three red IOU notes being torn up one by one while a green balance counter climbs by 2 each time; then a vertical ladder of equations descending −6, −4, −2, 0, 2, 4 with the step of +2 highlighted.
mood: Curious, then satisfied — the rule finally makes sense.
pacing: Slow through the debt picture, then the pattern ladder clicks down fast.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and never guess a sign again.
